fields.ideal_multipole_calibration_source_note: Ideal vacuum closed-coil order-3 current calibration at the original native reference plane; native strength in m^-3, matrix in A/(m^-3), reference energy 300000 eV. Fixed physical N, pack bounds and saved winding angular datum retained. Signed normal/skew on-axis Taylor coefficients use analytic Biot-Savart derivatives. No magnetic core, pole response, field-integral/profile equivalence, focus adjustment, thermal rating or experimental calibration is inferred. The numerical current reference stays fixed after energy or geometry edits; re-calibration is explicit.

Ideal vacuum closed-coil order-2 current calibration at the original native reference plane; native strength in m^-2, matrix in A/(m^-2), reference energy 300000 eV. Fixed physical N, pack bounds and saved winding angular datum retained. Signed normal/skew on-axis Taylor coefficients use analytic Biot-Savart derivatives. No magnetic core, pole response, field-integral/profile equivalence, focus adjustment, thermal rating or experimental calibration is inferred. The numerical current reference stays fixed after energy or geometry edits; re-calibration is explicit. This legacy image quadrupole has one existing native normal input; the second electrical target is an explicitly new engineering 45-degree-rotated copy of that normal coefficient, not a previously executed native skew control.
